name: Wasting Critical (Combat, Critical)
body:
After many battles against magical enemies you’ve learned to strike where it hurts most.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Critical, Mage Slayer.

Benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit against a creature with a spellcasting class feature or spell-like abilities its caster level is reduced by 1 for one minute. A successful Fortitude save reduces this to 1d4 rounds. The save DC is 10 + your base attack bonus. Multiple Wasting Criticals stack.

Special: You can only apply the effects of one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
